caption: The drawing depicts a single silver mug, which is cylindrical in shape with a slightly flared rim and a rounded base. The handle is attached on the left side and features a simple, curved design. The mug is rendered primarily in shades of gray and black, executed with pencil or graphite to depict the metallic reflection and texture of silver. Background shading in light brown, possibly added with a different medium such as watercolor or colored pencil, surrounds the mug and provides contrast. Text is handwritten above and below the mug; at the top left, it reads "SILVER MUG," "Maker. MARGUERITE HASTIER 1771." At the bottom, additional text includes "Case #69," "AMERICAN WING," "METROPOLITAN MUSEUM," "HEIGHT 5"'," and "JOHN GARAY." There are also some numerical notations in smaller writing under the case number. The drawing is centered on off-white or tan paper, with all included text and notes in gray or black ink or pencil.
title: Silver Mug
